moTa: Giám khảo AI hỏi đủ Part 1–2–3 (band 5.0). Part 1: food · travel · Part 2: an event you attended and enjoyed · Part 3: public events, celebrations past and present

phan.moTa: Câu hỏi ngắn về bản thân, 4–5 phút
Thẻ đề: 1 phút chuẩn bị, nói 1–2 phút
Thảo luận sâu hơn về chủ đề Part 2, 4–5 phút

buoc.loi: Good afternoon. My name is CuongMini, and I will be your examiner today. Can you tell me your full name, please?
Thank you. Now, in this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about food. What kind of food do you like most?
buoc.hoi: What kind of food do you like most?

buoc.loi: Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
buoc.hoi: Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?

buoc.loi: Is there any food you didn't like as a child but like now?
buoc.hoi: Is there any food you didn't like as a child but like now?

buoc.loi: Now let's talk about travel. Do you like travelling?
How do you usually travel when you go on holiday?
buoc.hoi: How do you usually travel when you go on holiday?

buoc.loi: Which place would you like to visit in the future? Why?
buoc.hoi: Which place would you like to visit in the future? Why?

the.de: Describe an event you attended that you enjoyed.
goiY: when and where it took place
and explain why you enjoyed it.

buoc.loi: Thank you. Now I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe an event you attended that you enjoyed.

buoc.hoi: Describe an event you attended that you enjoyed. You should say: — what the event was — when and where it took place — who you went with and explain why you enjoyed it.

the.de: Describe an event you attended that you enjoyed.
goiY: when and where it took place
and explain why you enjoyed it.

buoc.loi: All right? Remember, you have one to two minutes for this, so don't worry if I stop you. I'll tell you when the time is up. Can you start speaking now, please?
Thank you. Would you like to go to an event like this again?
buoc.hoi: Would you like to go to an event like this again?

buoc.loi: Did the people you went with enjoy it too?
buoc.hoi: Did the people you went with enjoy it too?

buoc.loi: We've been talking about the topic on your card, and I'd like to discuss with you one or two more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all public events. What kinds of public events are popular in your country?
buoc.hoi: What kinds of public events are popular in your country?

buoc.loi: Why do you think people enjoy going to big events such as festivals or concerts?
buoc.hoi: Why do you think people enjoy going to big events such as festivals or concerts?

buoc.loi: Is it better to watch a big event live or on a screen at home?
buoc.hoi: Is it better to watch a big event live or on a screen at home?

buoc.loi: Let's move on to celebrations, past and future. Are celebrations in your country different now from when your grandparents were young?
buoc.hoi: Are celebrations in your country different now from when your grandparents were young?

buoc.loi: If your town could hold a big international event, do you think it would be good for the town?
buoc.hoi: If your town could hold a big international event, do you think it would be good for the town?

buoc.loi: Thank you very much. That is the end of the speaking test.
